name: cli-task-manager
description: Gerenciador de tarefas em linha de comando (CLI) em Node.js ESM

scripts.build:bin:win: npm run build:bundle && caxa --input dist --output dist/tarefas.exe -- "{{caxa}}/node_modules/.bin/node" "{{caxa}}/bundle.cjs"
scripts.build:bin:linux: npm run build:bundle && caxa --input dist --output dist/tarefas-linux -- "{{caxa}}/node_modules/.bin/node" "{{caxa}}/bundle.cjs"
